sql
---
CREATE VIEW sales_by_film_category
AS
SELECT
c.name AS category
, SUM(p.amount) AS total_sales
FROM payment AS p
INNER JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
INNER JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
INNER JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
INNER JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
INNER JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.name

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM main.payment AS p
    JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_film_counts AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fr.film_id) AS paid_film_count
    FROM main.actor AS a
    LEFT JOIN main.film_actor AS fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
    LEFT JOIN film_revenue AS fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
),
rank_checks AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.actor_id ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM main.film_actor AS fa
    JOIN film_revenue AS fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor_film_counts) AS actor_count,
    (SELECT MIN(paid_film_count) FROM actor_film_counts) AS min_paid_films_per_actor,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_revenue WHERE total_revenue <= 0) AS nonpositive_film_totals,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.payment WHERE ABS(amount * 100 - ROUND(amount * 100)) > 0.000001) AS subcent_payments,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.film) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT title) FROM main.film) AS duplicate_film_titles,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
        SELECT actor_id
        FROM rank_checks
        WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
        GROUP BY actor_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
    )) AS actors_tied_at_cutoff

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id,
           ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_film_revenue
    FROM main.payment AS p
    JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_cast_counts AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count
    FROM main.film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked_actor_films AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id,
           fa.film_id,
           fr.total_film_revenue,
           fr.total_film_revenue / fc.actor_count AS actor_film_revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY fa.actor_id
               ORDER BY fr.total_film_revenue DESC, fa.film_id
           ) AS film_rank
    FROM main.film_actor AS fa
    JOIN film_revenue AS fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
    JOIN film_cast_counts AS fc ON fc.film_id = fa.film_id
)
SELECT a.actor_id,
       a.first_name,
       a.last_name,
       f.title,
       raf.total_film_revenue,
       raf.actor_film_revenue,
       AVG(raf.actor_film_revenue) OVER (
           PARTITION BY raf.actor_id
       ) AS average_actor_revenue_in_top_films
FROM ranked_actor_films AS raf
JOIN main.actor AS a ON a.actor_id = raf.actor_id
JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = raf.film_id
WHERE raf.film_rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, raf.film_rank
LIMIT -1
